// diagnostic E2821

Jet.StateWithoutScreen

No screen of the app graph opens `{state}`.

What

No screen of the app graph opens `{state}`.

Why

Every target runs the program's one app graph, and only a `.screen` whose view takes `{state}` gives it an address, so a link, push or mail that opens it would open nothing on any target.

Fix

Register a screen whose view takes `{state}` in the graph, as `.screen("/path/:field", view)`, or open the state of a screen the graph registers.

Worked example
